answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 66508 Country: United Kingdom Title: Am I mahram or non-mahram to my foster son’s wife? Question: I am a Muslim brother of 25. Am I mahram or non-mahram to my foster son’s wife? (Child that was breastfed by my wife while under the age of two). Am I mahram or non-mahram to my foster son’s children? Answer ID: 66508 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1161/1233/L=11/1437) As the wife of real son is mahram, in the same way the wife of foster son is also a mahram . It is not necessary to observe purdah from her. Its detail is available in the footnote of Sharh Wiqaya. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
